encoder_method_note:
The message is carried by the ten building silhouettes, read left to right: each building's `height` attribute is exactly 10 times the alphabet position (A=1 … Z=26) of one letter, so heights 130, 50, 50, 200, 10, 200, 40, 10, 230, 140 give 13, 5, 5, 20, 1, 20, 4, 1, 23, 14 → M, E, E, T, A, T, D, A, W, N. All buildings share the same width (28) so height is the only varying property, and the word breaks are marked structurally by wider gaps between building groups (20 px between words versus 6 px within a word), splitting the sequence into 4-2-4 letters: "meet at dawn". The windows, moon, stars, and ground are purely decorative and carry no information.
